notes.title: Please Contact us if you want Release Override Keys! Thanks!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

Happy New Year! Werther Quest is now in the final test for the full version. We would like to express our sincere gratitude to those who have added it to their wishlist. It's your trust and support that makes Werther Quest Greenlit and available on Steam! Thank you all! In return,we have requested some keys from Valve to those who have interest in Werther Quest and require immediate access to the game.Perhaps we will have a review on your request since the number of Release Override keys is samll, but it all depends. Anyway we'll try our best to satisfy your request for immediate access by other means. Now you can directly email your request to us at sylvialiaosl@gmail.com or leave your email address below. We'll send it to you as soon as possible.

To conclude, Werther wish you a joyous New Year and much happiness,my friends! 

Thank you!
Blueberry Studio
